text:
Nora (Hiring Manager): New PM starts Monday. Need a short manager-facing checklist and a 3-line 30/60/90 I can DM. Priorities: access, buddy, 1:1 schedule.
Sam (People Ops): Quick manager checklist (copy/paste):
- Pre-start: confirm device & shipping, SSO invite, add to team calendar events
- Day 0: HR forms + welcome Slack intro, confirm email/Slack access
- Day 1: 60-min product + roadmap overview (mgr + buddy), verify repo/staging access
- Day 2: assign a tiny discovery ticket, pair with buddy for setup
- Day 3: stakeholder intros, metrics tour, schedule weekly 1:1s (8 weeks)
- End of week: share 30/60/90 draft and three success signals
Nora (Hiring Manager): Can you also give me a compact 30/60/90 paragraph?
Sam (People Ops): Pasteable 30/60/90: 
- 30 days: complete onboarding checklist, learn product flows, deliver a one-page discovery note.
- 60 days: own a small backlog area, run a cross-team sync, ship independent PRs.
- 90 days: lead a scoped project to release, show measurable improvement on target metric, maintain steady stakeholder cadence.
Kai (IT): Device order placed. If MDM delays, we'll issue a temporary cloud dev account. Tell me if they need SaaS (Figma/Amplitude).
Diego (Buddy): I'll run the repo tour day1 and pair on the first ticket day2. Adding a short "who to ask" snippet: repos -> Eng Lead, staging -> QA, deploys -> Devops.
onboard-bot: Reminder set: "New hire Day0 welcome" scheduled for 2024-08-05 09:00.
Nora (Hiring Manager): Thanks everyone. I'll DM the candidate the agenda and drop the manager checklist in the templates repo.
